description: List the saved Work boards (the Work queue board picker). A board whose columns follow a label group carries `labelColumns.labelGroupId` and `columnLabels`, the stage labels in column order; list the cards of one column with anyforge_list_work_items and `label`. Boards are a view over work items, not work items, so a search of the work items never finds a board or a label group by name.
name: anyforge_list_work_boards
title: List work boards
